mapper.update: UPDATE potential_customer SET is_active = CASE WHEN birth_date <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 21 YEAR) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL AND ( is_active IS NULL OR is_active <> CASE WHEN birth_date <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 21 YEAR) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END )
